{"operationName":"ProductTaxonomyList","variables":{"taxonomyId":"gid://shopify/ProductTaxonomyNode/7550","childrenOf":"gid://shopify/ProductTaxonomyNode/7550","hasTaxonomyId":true,"status":["ACTIVE"]},"query":"query ProductTaxonomyList($childrenOf: ID, $taxonomyId: ID = "gid://shopify/ProductTaxonomyNode/1", $hasTaxonomyId: Boolean!, $taxonomyOwner: ProductTaxonomyOwnerInput, $status: [ProductTaxonomyNodeStatusType!]) {
  productTaxonomy(
    childrenOf: $childrenOf
    taxonomyOwner: $taxonomyOwner
    status: $status
  ) {
    id
    name
    isRoot
    isLeaf
    parentId
    fullName
    level
    publicId
    isArchived
    __typename
  }
  taxonomyNode: productTaxonomyNode(
    id: $taxonomyId
    taxonomyOwner: $taxonomyOwner
    status: $status
  ) @include(if: $hasTaxonomyId) {
    ... on ProductTaxonomyNode {
      id
      name
      isRoot
      isLeaf
      parentId
      fullName
      level
      publicId
      isArchived
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
}

{"operationName":"ProductTaxonomyList","variables":{"taxonomyId":"gid://shopify/ProductTaxonomyNode/5930","childrenOf":"gid://shopify/ProductTaxonomyNode/5930","hasTaxonomyId":true,"status":["ACTIVE"]},"query":"query ProductTaxonomyList($childrenOf: ID, $taxonomyId: ID = "gid://shopify/ProductTaxonomyNode/1", $hasTaxonomyId: Boolean!, $taxonomyOwner: ProductTaxonomyOwnerInput, $status: [ProductTaxonomyNodeStatusType!]) {
  productTaxonomy(
    childrenOf: $childrenOf
    taxonomyOwner: $taxonomyOwner
    status: $status
  ) {
    id
    name
    isRoot
    isLeaf
    parentId
    fullName
    level
    publicId
    isArchived
    __typename
  }
  taxonomyNode: productTaxonomyNode(
    id: $taxonomyId
    taxonomyOwner: $taxonomyOwner
    status: $status
  ) @include(if: $hasTaxonomyId) {
    ... on ProductTaxonomyNode {
      id
      name
      isRoot
      isLeaf
      parentId
      fullName
      level
      publicId
      isArchived
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
}
"}

data:
{"operationName":"ProductTaxonomyList","variables":{"taxonomyId":"gid://shopify/ProductTaxonomyNode/9532","childrenOf":"gid://shopify/ProductTaxonomyNode/9532","hasTaxonomyId":true,"status":["ACTIVE"]},"query":"query ProductTaxonomyList($childrenOf: ID, $taxonomyId: ID = "gid://shopify/ProductTaxonomyNode/1", $hasTaxonomyId: Boolean!, $taxonomyOwner: ProductTaxonomyOwnerInput, $status: [ProductTaxonomyNodeStatusType!]) {
  productTaxonomy(
    childrenOf: $childrenOf
    taxonomyOwner: $taxonomyOwner
    status: $status
  ) {
    id
    name
    isRoot
    isLeaf
    parentId
    fullName
    level
    publicId
    isArchived
    __typename
  }
  taxonomyNode: productTaxonomyNode(
    id: $taxonomyId
    taxonomyOwner: $taxonomyOwner
    status: $status
  ) @include(if: $hasTaxonomyId) {
    ... on ProductTaxonomyNode {
      id
      name
      isRoot
      isLeaf
      parentId
      fullName
      level
      publicId
      isArchived
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
}
"}
